$comment: Trilingual SMS bodies (Si/Ta/En) — the platform rule is that no user-facing string is
hardcoded (CLAUDE.md, D-26). Embedded in the assembly rather than read from disk so a
container image cannot ship without them.
Placeholders are {code} and {minutes}. Keep every body inside 70 characters of Unicode if
you can: Sinhala and Tamil force UCS-2, where one SMS segment is 70 characters rather than
160, and a two-segment OTP costs twice as much on every sign-in in the country.
Language keys are the iam.users.language values si | ta | en (C003 CHECK).

otp.en: {code} is your MageRide code. Valid {minutes} min. Never share it.
otp.si: {code} ඔබගේ MageRide කේතයයි. මිනිත්තු {minutes}ක් වලංගුයි. කිසිවෙකුට නොදෙන්න.
otp.ta: {code} — MageRide குறியீடு. {minutes} நிமிடம் செல்லும். பகிர வேண்டாம்.
